notes.title: Small Update 1.0.4 Patch Notes

v. 1.0.4 patch notes
Chess
--Pawn Promotion correctly updates visuals
--Pieces Tutorial

notes.title: Globe Games 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
V. 1.0.3 patch notes

Chess
--Block check now correctly resets valid moves and pins piece
--Game now properly detecting check by pawn
--Check is now visually represented by a pair of swords over the King
--Attacks are not visually represented by a sword over the pieces that can be taken
--Changed Pawn Promotion tiles to include pawn start positions of the opposing player.
--Online - Can now deselect pieces when it’s not your turn.
--Online - Can no longer click to move other player’s pieces
Pieces Tutorial
--Pawn Attack Tutorial - Click to take now displays checkmark
Online
--Player 1 Turn Indicator moved to the left of Steam Icon.
--Added 1 Minute time control
--Clock now correctly resets when rejoining a game or starting a new game, and synched each move.
--Clock now correctly loads player info when starting
--GameOver window now displays the game result
Settings
--SetColor button turns green on color change
--Increased Tile collider size to detect mouse clicks closer to actual side of the tile.

notes.title: Release and v. 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Globe! The game is now live!

Menu/Options
--Credits and Social Media
--ResetMenu() if join lobby fails
--LeaveLobby if clicked back to Online Game
--Lerp camera zoom
--Time Control in LobbyMember view

Settings
--Color selection of whole button not just color

SteamManager
--Start Game only enabled when Host has an active connection.
--GameServer handles turn updates by sending server messages
--CloseListenSocket on return to MainMenu if server is open
--Clear old connections
--Invite Cooldown

Online Games
--Added disconnection indicator
--Rejoin / join lobby in progress (Othello, Go, Chess)
--Set Player Color in Lobby
--Close Lobby if host disconnects

Chess
--Fixed RemoteMove causes piece type to increment (bad promotion).
--Solitaire now correctly Resets
--Solitaire now correctly allows New Game
--Click to take enemy piece (if not valid move)
--Click to Deselect (if not valid move)
--Fixed Pawn promotion checkmate did not trigger gameOver

Go
--Fixed OnlineClock Menu Position
--Load Game - Groups not working
--Only Pass on Turn;	

Othello
--Added scoreboard
--Show available Moves
